label: Read rekordbox's library database
helpOff: Off. Your rekordbox collection is read from its XML export.
helpOn: Reads a copy of rekordbox's library database. The database itself is never changed. Sending to rekordbox still uses an XML export, so export again before you send.
error: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.

failure.turnedOff: Reading the database is turned off.
failure.wrongKey: Wrong key, or a database format this app doesn't read.
failure.damaged: The database file is cut off or damaged.
failure.notALibrary: That file isn't a rekordbox library.
